\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]
\footnotesize
\item \textit{Notes:} Pooled intraday linear models and tree ensembles, one design for every row: the HAR components at horizons $k \in \{1, 5, 25, 125, 625, 3125\}$, the full predictor set with the FOMC series, penalties chosen once on four validation folds covering 2008--2011, before the first forecast, and then frozen, a rolling window of 1{,}000 trading days, re-estimated every interval (Section~\ref{sec:rh_methods}), trained and scored on the 13 regular-hours half-hour bars ending 10:00 to 16:00~ET. Every bar is scored on the $T_{\mathrm{oos}} = \rhorDays$ trading days from \rhorSpanStart{} to \rhorSpanEnd{} (early closes dropped), \rhorNIntB{} bars (bars with a non-positive realized variance dropped); each forecast $\hat\sigma^2_{t,i} = \hat y^{2}_{t,i}\, s^2_{t,i}$ is scored against the actual realized variance $\RV_{t,i}$ of its interval. MSE (in units of $10^{-\rhoosMseExp}$) and QLIKE are averages over the scored intervals. $R^2_{\mathrm{OOS}} = 1 - \sum (\RV_{t,i} - \hat\sigma^2_{t,i})^2 / \sum (\RV_{t,i} - \overline{\RV}_{t-1,i})^2$, in percent, where $\overline{\RV}_{t-1,i}$ is the historical mean realized variance of the same half-hour interval over every earlier trading day from \rhoosBenchStart{} \citep{CampbellThompson2008}. DM: the Diebold--Mariano statistic, with the correction of \citet{HarveyLeybourneNewbold1997}, for the daily average QLIKE of the full predictor set minus that of the HAR benchmark of the same model (negative: the full set has the lower loss), Newey--West lag 8, $p$-value in parentheses. LightGBM, XGBoost and the random forest use the same design and the same 1{,}000-trading-day window, are refit at every bar, and keep hyperparameters chosen once on the 1998--2002 pre-sample and then frozen. Models trained on the last 30 minutes are in Table~\ref{tab:rh_oos_last30}.
\end{tablenotes}
